catalysts.headline: Reported Q3 2026 results: GAAP loss of $0.46/share, beating consensus; company remains pre-revenue (DT120 not yet approved)

Reported Q3 2026 results (quarter ended 2026-09-30): operating expenses $72.3M (+58% YoY); cash & short-term investments $1.05B (runway guided into 2030); also disclosed early Phase 2a DT402 autism data (small, n=5, uncontrolled, but positive) alongside the financial results

Presented topline Phase 3 DT120 ODT data in an oral Scientific Exchange session at the 2026 NEI (Neuroscience Education Institute) Fall Congress in Colorado Springs, CO (congress ran Nov 5-8, 2026); company described it as the first comprehensive presentation to date of the combined Panorama (GAD), Emerge (MDD) and Voyage (GAD) Phase 3 program
Announced it would report Q3 2026 financial results on November 9, 2026
Definium Therapeutics announced it will report Q3 2026 (quarter ended Sept 30, 2026) financial results on November 9, 2026, with a webcast at 4:30 PM EST
FDA granted Breakthrough Therapy Designation for DT120 ODT in major depressive disorder; also reported positive topline Phase 3 Panorama (GAD) results

Positive Phase 3 Panorama topline for DT120 ODT in generalized anxiety disorder: 100µg dose showed 5.1-point placebo-adjusted HAM-A improvement at Week 12 (p<0.0001, Cohen's d=0.64); DT120 holds FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation for GAD and MDD; pre-NDA meeting planned 4Q 2026, NDA filing planned 1H 2027
catalysts.impact: Shares reportedly up ~20% on the session

catalysts.headline: Positive Phase 3 Panorama topline for DT120 ODT in generalized anxiety disorder: 100µg dose showed 5.1-point placebo-adjusted HAM-A improvement at Week 12 (p<0.0001, Cohen's d=0.64; LS mean change -9.8 vs -4.7 placebo); efficacy observed by Day 2 and sustained through Week 12; generally well tolerated. Third positive Phase 3 readout overall (after Emerge in MDD and Voyage in GAD). Pre-NDA meeting planned 4Q 2026, NDA filing planned 1H 2027. DT120 holds FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation for both GAD and MDD.
Definium Therapeutics announces positive Phase 3 Panorama topline results for DT120 ODT in generalized anxiety disorder (HAM-A placebo-adjusted difference of 5.1 points); plans NDA filing 1H 2027

Positive Phase 3 Voyage topline for DT120 ODT in generalized anxiety disorder: placebo-adjusted HAM-A change at Week 12 of 5.4 points (p<0.0001, Cohen's d=0.81); LS mean HAM-A reduction of 11.6 points (DT120) vs 6.2 points (placebo)
